name: Ahmad Shaharuddin
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, where he immersed himself in engineering, spending countless hours designing and building race car components. After graduating, he joined a local Malaysian racing team, quickly rising through the ranks from a junior mechanic to a team engineer. His dedication and innovative solutions caught the attention of Manthey Racing, who recruited him to oversee their Asian operations. 

As a Sporting Director, Ahmad believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers and drivers can freely exchange ideas. His hands-on approach and deep understanding of vehicle dynamics allow him to quickly identify and resolve technical challenges. He's known for his ability to think outside the box, often proposing unconventional strategies that give his team a competitive edge. He is determined to make Manthey a dominant force in Asian racing.

What distinguishes Ahmad is his remarkable ability to stay calm under pressure, even in the most chaotic race situations. He possess a unique talent for analyzing vast amounts of data, swiftly distilling critical information, and making informed decisions that can turn the tide of a race. His colleagues know he is always pushing for better understanding and higher performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Ahmad is a lean man of average height with a focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Prefers to work late into the night when the pit lane is quiet.
